title: Roundtables: Inside the Quest for Cognitive Immortality
author: MIT Technology Review
text:
Available only for MIT Technology Review subscribers.
Tuesday, November 17, 2026 In an effort to reach an elusive continuity of the self, some far-thinking technologists are working on ways to keep your brain going—even beyond death. Join science editor Mary Beth Griggs and senior editor for biomedicine Antonio Regalado for a conversation exploring possible paths to keep your mind going, including gradual brain replacement and uploading our memories to the cloud. Going live at 17:00 GMT / 12pm EST / 9am PST Register Now Related Stories: Six wild ideas for perpetuating your mind Inside the stealthy startup that pitched brainless human clones Technology that lets us “speak” to our dead relatives has arrived. Are we ready?
